- HOSTED CAMERA-SITE ENTITY RESOLUTION (P30.2b, 2026-09-24, ADR-105): the reviewed camera-site ER pass ran as a Cloud Run job next to Cloud SQL (execution sig-materialize-fh2bh, role sig_materialize, image materialize-7db63484444f) over 230,330 observation-level camera records: 30,360 blocked candidate pairs -> 13,572 recorded same_as decisions (2,337 auto-written: tier 1g 1,089 + tier 3g 1,248; 11,235 proposed to human review), N = 227,998 resolved sites, dedup ratio 0.0101 (2,332 same-device merges; cluster sizes 2 x 2,322, 3 x 5); 0 cluster-shape alerts. - WHAT THE NUMBERS MEAN: about 1% of observation-level camera records are the same device as another source's record under rules whose STRICT holdout precision cleared the 0.98 floor with >= 50 holdout pairs (tier 1g 70/70, tier 3g 69/70 on the frozen agent-verified holdout). Most records have no cross-source counterpart; every uncertain candidate (proximity only, co-located devices, soft conflicts, refused unions) is proposed for review and NOT counted. Of the multi-record sites, 273 span two or more independent lineages and 2054 are republished copies within one lineage (not independent corroboration). Value-resolved coordinates (230,330) remain a separate, non-dedup figure.
- The camera-site eval is PROVISIONAL: the holdout is agent-verified (not field-verified), the blind LLM adjudicator's kappa (0.669) missed the 0.70 bar so it is a suggester only, and tier 3g scores 0.800 under the LLM's labels (it reads sub-metre offsets between republished copies as proximity only) — the first-principles half of D-R6.1-EVAL stays OPEN.

## Camera-site entity resolution (P30.2b, ADR-105)

- **the unit:** an observation-level record is one source's row for one camera; a **resolved site** is a cluster of records judged to be the SAME PHYSICAL DEVICE. M = observation-level records, N = post-ER clusters (singletons included), N <= M, dedup ratio = 1 - N/M. A §28 value decision within one record is never a resolved site.
- rules `camera_site_rules.toml` v2, resolver `camera-sites/1.0.0`, run key `camsite:13bedfe7f754a3cf219c90865fc8a81e8eb15135`
- gold set `camera-2`: 540 double-adjudicated pairs, frozen holdout 180 (agent/maintainer-verified)
- Cohen's κ (blind LLM adjudicator vs agent seed): **0.669** (bar ≥ 0.70) → LLM trusted as gold: **no — suggester only**; disputed pairs: 77 (routed to review)
